equation_entries.ontology: Measurement model discrepancy diagnostic, not an addition to UET action or state
equation_entries.units: E=cq+eta q3+b4 q4+zeta q5; native b4:E^-3 or measured b4:meV angstrom^4
equation_entries.equation: delta_beta_k=b4*sum_i W_ki*q_i^3; at fixed ratios quintic alias is proportional to b4/q_max
equation_entries.claim_boundary: A possible q4 term spoils three-node q5 extraction without a bound; not evidence that UET action must be changed

equation_entries.ontology: Alternative coefficient estimator including one explicit nuisance basis, not calibrated physics
equation_entries.units: f=E/q has powers0,2,3,4; measured coefficients meV angstrom^(1,3,4,5)
equation_entries.claim_boundary: Four points separate only the declared four basis coefficients; not all-order model selection, optimal design or thermal calibration

precision_extension.method: Independent mpmath LU with exact fraction inputs and column scaling; does not assign instrument precision
